version.changelog: 万豪品牌专属数据源暂停，调整为服务引导版本

llm.summary: This skill is a decommissioned Courtyard hotel lookup entry point that only returns a disclosed guidance message and does not access accounts, files, networks, or booking systems.

dimensions.detail: The Python script imports only json and sys, parses optional CLI JSON arguments, and returns a static notice; it performs no network calls, file reads or writes, credential access, or local indexing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a small markdown skill file, metadata, and one local Python script with no dependency installation, remote retrieval, or installer behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions and outputs are Chinese-only and tell the assistant/user to use other hotel skills for live search or booking, but there is no hidden prompt manipulation or unrelated instruction scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, scheduled tasks, or modification of agent behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to preserve legacy Courtyard hotel search/detail/package tool names while informing users that the dedicated data source is offline and routing them toward general hotel-search skills; the script behavior matches that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, expect this skill to provide a Chinese-language notice rather than live Courtyard hotel search or booking. Use it only if that legacy compatibility behavior is useful; live prices or reservations would come from separate hotel skills, not this package.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only service notice is real, but it is consistent with the Chinese skill name, description, documentation, and apparent target audience; it is a usability/localization limitation rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only CLI help/status text is present, but the CLI is only a compatibility wrapper returning the same service-adjustment notice and does not expand authority or hide behavior.
